description: The Science Data Bank deposit contains 2015 land-cover classifications for 25 port cities and their surrounding areas along the Belt and Road maritime route. The Yantai Institute of Coastal Zone Research produced separate city files from Landsat 8 OLI imagery using a support-vector machine classifier and the GlobeLand30 class convention. The article describes 30-metre rasters and ancillary files; the named repository page lists CC BY 4.0. An infrastructure modeller could use these layers to set land-cover conditions around port access roads, exposed settlements or coastal facilities. The product is a selected set of cities in multiple countries, not continuous global coverage. It depicts land cover in 2015 and does not encode port assets, cargo volumes or later land-use change. The journal reports classification checking, but class-specific accuracy and coordinate consistency were not assessed here. Neither the rasters nor the older archive were downloaded. No directly related catalogue or earlier-review record was found in the full duplicate scan.
